suite.shortBio: Open-source suite for long-term projects with your own coding agents: Outpost, Mission Control, the Agent Kit CLI and the Oligarchy game.
suite.longBio: Mission Kit is a suite for developing and maintaining long-term projects with your own coding agents: Outpost for Linux, Mission Control for IDE, Agent Kit CLI and the Oligarchy game. Open source under Apache-2.0.

outpost.shortBio: Hybrid development environment for Linux with project management and DevOps built in. Alpha. Part of Mission Kit.
outpost.longBio: Outpost is a hybrid development environment built on a Rust core and Tauri 2, with project management and DevOps built in. Alpha for Linux. Part of Mission Kit.

oligarchy.shortBio: A strategy game that runs beside Outpost. The work you ship rebuilds a grey planet and holds it against the Oligarchy.
oligarchy.longBio: A strategy game that runs beside Outpost. The work you ship rebuilds a grey planet and holds it against the Oligarchy. Part of Mission Kit.
